_help: Settings for PC Crash Reporter. Edit with Notepad, save, and the change applies after the next restart. Temperatures are in degrees C.
_PsuWatts_help: Set this to your power supply's wattage (printed on its label, e.g. 650) to get warnings when your PC gets close to its limit. 0 = unknown.
_UseHardwareSensors_help: true = read temperatures, power and fan speeds with LibreHardwareMonitor (recommended). false = only basic Windows readings (CPU/RAM load, NVIDIA GPU) - use this if the hardware sensor driver causes problems with anti-cheat or other software.
